editorial:
Imagine a quiet, lonely guy who runs a pawnshop and barely talks to anyone. That's Cha Tae-sik, a former special agent hiding from his past. His only friend is a little girl named So-mi who lives next door. When she gets kidnapped by a ruthless crime ring involved in drugs and organ trafficking, he drops everything and goes on a violent mission to bring her home. The story pulls you in fast and never lets go.

The action here is intense and raw, with some of the best knife fights you'll ever see on screen. Won Bin is fantastic as the silent hero, and the young actress playing So-mi makes you care deeply about her safety. The pacing is tight, though the villains can feel a bit cartoonish at times and the violence is very graphic. If you love gritty revenge thrillers with real heart, this one is for you. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, Cha Tae-sik storms the crime ring's hideout and takes down the gang leaders in brutal hand-to-hand combat. He finally finds So-mi alive but traumatized. The twist is that the gang boss's brother was the one who originally killed Cha's wife and unborn child, which is why he became a recluse. After rescuing So-mi, Cha walks away with her, finally finding peace and a reason to live again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty revenge thrillers and intense action.
